development: Covestro's Dormagen TDI plant is expected to lose about 27 kt of output in September
context: After about 41 kt lost in January to March. Dormagen is 330 of Europe's 580 kt of TDI; across both European plants about 110 kt, 19% of capacity, is expected to be lost in 2026.
internal_note: Isocyanate market letter, issue of 1 July 2026, 2026 capacity-curtailed table (estimates by the publisher, month by month): Dormagen 14/13/14 Jan-Mar, 27 Sep

development: BASF's 300 kt Ludwigshafen TDI plant is reported closed, part of a cut of about 40% in European TDI capacity since 2023
context: It leaves Covestro Dormagen and BorsodChem as the only European TDI plants.
internal_note: EUROPUR FY2025 report, published August 2026 - Table 28 shows Ludwigshafen 300 in 2021 and none from 2025; Table 23 names the closed line as Schwarzheide. The plant name follows Table 28
